model_output.score_comment_short: Recent sales results and customer size are clear, with a few contributions unexplained.
model_output.score_comment_long: The 2025 revenue and quota figures give a reviewer a concrete performance reference. The referral program also shows how you sourced deals. The demo and security review bullet leaves your contribution less clear. Adding that detail would make the sales process easier to understand.
model_output.score_plain: Your recent work gives reviewers a useful basis for assessing mid-market sales roles. A few more specifics would help them distinguish your approach from a standard account executive job description.
model_output.first_impression: The move from SDR to mid-market account executive is easy to follow. Closing $1.1M in new annual recurring revenue in 2025 gives the recent role a useful performance anchor.
model_output.biggest_gap_example: "Work with solutions engineers on demos and security reviews" doesn't explain your part in either activity, so a reviewer can't see how you handle those sales stages.
model_output.summary: You sell HR software to mid-market companies and have progressed from prospecting to full-cycle sales. The 108% quota figure makes the 2025 revenue result easier to assess, while the payroll partnerships show another way you sourced deals. The recent title and work point to an account executive level. More detail about your role in demos and security reviews would help a reviewer understand how you work through complex sales.
